items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have pianist Richard Wyands with me today. Thanks for coming. [INTERVIEWEE] My pleasure.

ctx.x: Pianist Richard Wyands was born in Oakland, California on July 2, 1928. He gained valuable experience backing guest soloists at The Blackhawk and went on to accompany some of the best singers in jazz. Richard enjoyed a fruitful relationship with guitarist Kenny Burrell and has been a favored sideman on numerous recordings throughout his career.
Richard was interviewed in New York City on January 7, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
We are in Manhattan filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have pianist Richard Wyands with me today. Thanks for coming.
